name: Nerd Utility API
description: Free, no-auth micro-service API with 145+ endpoints: format converters (base64/base32/base58/punycode/hex), validators (IBAN, SWIFT/BIC, JWT, Luhn, ISBN, semver, cron, EIP-55 ETH addresses, credit card, MIME, domain/DNS), parsers (user-agent, barcode, JWT), crypto helpers (Caesar/Vigenere/NATO), data lookups (elements, airports, emoji, geo), text tools (case, diff, regex, HTML entities), generators (password, UUID, faker, lorem), and more.
